title: Nourishing Slovakian Rice Casserole
description: A rich and savory Slovakian-inspired rice casserole that's perfect for a date night. The combination of creamy cheese and sweet confit tomato creates a deliciously satisfying meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375f Fahrenheit (190f Celsius).
Grease the bottom of a 6-quart Dutch oven with the melted coconut oil.
Cook the bacon in a skillet until crispy, then chop into small pieces and set aside.
In the same skillet, saut4 the chopped onion until translucent, then add the minced garlic and cook for an additional minute.
In a large mixing bowl, combine the cooked rice, confit tomato, shredded Gruy4 cheese, chopped onion and garlic mixture, crispy bacon, salt, and black pepper. Toss until well combined.
Transfer the rice mixture to the prepared Dutch oven and cover with a lid.
Bake for 30 minutes at 375f Fahrenheit (190f Celsius).
Remove the lid and continue baking for an additional 10-15 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Remove from the oven and sprinkle with chopped parsley. Serve immediately!
